name: netease-music-float
description: Floating Now Playing widget for macOS and Windows music players.
author: baitang-bt

scripts.check: node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node --check electron/state-store.js && node --check electron/media-controller.js && node --check electron/media-remote.js && node --check electron/windows-media-controller.js && node --check electron/music-players.js && node --check electron/auto-update.js && node --check electron/netease-app.js && node --check electron/netease-playback-mode.js && node --check electron/netease-lyrics.js && node --check electron/audio-capture.js && node --check electron/audio-permission.js && node --check electron/fft.js && node --check electron/netease-identity.js && node --check electron/paths.js && node --check src/float.js && node --check src/spectrum.js && node --check src/theme-colors.js && node --check src/title-fonts.js && node --check src/settings.js && node --check scripts/after-pack.js && node --check scripts/start-electron.js && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.dist:mac: bash scripts/ensure-signing-identity.sh && NETEASEFLOAT_SIGN_IDENTITY="NeteaseFloat Local" CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.release: bash scripts/ensure-signing-identity.sh && NETEASEFLOAT_SIGN_IDENTITY="NeteaseFloat Local" CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac zip dmg -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist --publish always

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: NeteaseFloat 需要「仅系统音频录制」权限以绘制真实声浪频谱。
